baza-owner.title: PK XD PORTAL OWNER GUIDE
baza-owner.description: How to become an Owner in PK XD PORTAL
paragraphs: An Owner leads one area of the Portal.
They are not the boss. They are responsible for the development and order of their area.
Owners create ideas and events and help the Portal grow.
You're not just on the team. You're building the Portal's future.
➤ If you make no contribution for 2 weeks, you are demoted to Archon.
➤ You can return as an Owner after 4 weeks if you pass the test and internship again.
➤ You may take 1 week off per month if you notify the team beforehand.
➤ Sharing internal information, posts or team materials with members is prohibited.
➤ Toxic behavior and conflicts within the Owner team are prohibited.
Each Owner chooses 1 or 2 areas to manage.
Creates avatars, banners, cards and other visual materials. Maintains the Portal's visual style.
Creates events, challenges, heroes and villains. Develops the atmosphere and stories behind events.
Publishes news as Pixie, shares spoilers, updates and important announcements.
Tracks PK XD pet information. Creates trade-channel posts and helps with trades, exchanges and pet values.
➤ Contribute to the Portal every week
➤ Maintain the quality of content and ideas
➤ Help other roles and support the team

baza-admin.title: PK XD PORTAL ADMIN GUIDE
baza-admin.description: How to become an Admin in PK XD PORTAL
paragraphs: Your job is to maintain order, a welcoming atmosphere and safety. Admins help members, enforce the rules and keep chats calm.
The following are prohibited in the Portal:
➤ Insults and toxic behavior (even as a joke)
➤ Spam (3+ identical messages in a row)
➤ Advertising (links and promotions are prohibited, mentions are allowed)
➤ Wishing death upon others (even as a joke)
➤ Not knowing the rules does not exempt you from responsibility
➤ You can appeal a warn or ban through the punishment appeal system
➤ Remove spam, ads and rule-breaking content
➤ Mute someone because of personal dislike
➤ Use the role to gain power
➤ Argue aggressively while representing the admin team
Swearing / Spam / Advertising / Shipping / Toxic behavior
4. If repeated, issue the next warn
“Please stop arguing. Insults and fights are prohibited in the Portal.”
4. Inform an Owner if the case is serious
5. If confirmed, issue a global ban
➤ A situation the admin is unsure about
Admins may not reduce punishments for friends, acquaintances or popular members. The rules apply equally to everyone.
An Admin may become an Owner if they:
➤ Contribute beyond moderation to the Portal's development
➤ Pass the Owner test and internship
Owner is the next level of responsibility.

добро-пожаловать-в-pk-xd-portal.title: Welcome to PK XD PORTAL
добро-пожаловать-в-pk-xd-portal.description: PK XD PORTAL is a community dedicated to PK XD, with news, events, trading, chat and community creations.
paragraphs: This channel is your place for everything PK XD: contests, community creations and many other activities. We work to make the Portal engaging and easy to use. Our friendly Owners and Admins are here to help. You can learn about them here: https://t.me/bio_owners_pkxdportal 😇
🌀 The Portal has three main sections:
➤ PK XD PORTAL (https://t.me/pkxdportal) — news, fan art, essential information and community chat.
➤ PK XD PORTAL TRADES (http://t.me/pkxdportal_trades) — a place for safer trades with a trust system.
➤ PK XD PORTAL GAMES (https://t.me/pkxdportal_games) — events, activities and mini-games.
You can join all our channels and chats in seconds. Open https://t.me/addlist/aw6pZH4f0R01ZDUy and add the collection to get the Portal folder 🔥
Please read the chat rules at https://t.me/pkxdportal/56
to help keep the community friendly 😊
